{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "---
name: Test Python package with Tox

on: ["push", "pull_request"]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      max-parallel: 4
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version:
          - "3.7"
          - "3.8"
          - "3.9"
          - "3.10"
          - "3.11"
          - "3.12"
          - "3.13"
          - "3.14"
          - "3.15.0-alpha - 3.15"
        include:
          - os: "ubuntu-latest"
          - os: "ubuntu-22.04"
            python-version: "3.7"

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install tox tox-gh-actions coverage
      - name: Test with tox
        run: tox
      - name: Produce coverage.lcov for coveralls
        if: matrix.python-version == '3.14'
        run: coverage lcov
      - name: Coveralls
        if: matrix.python-version == '3.14'
        uses: coverallsapp/github-action@5cbfd81b66ca5d10c19b062c04de0199c215fb6e # v2.3.7",
  "rationale": "The workflow installs Python dependencies (pip, tox, tox-gh-actions, coverage) on every matrix job with no dependency cache, so repeated runs re-fetch wheels. The repository has pyproject.toml, satisfying the cache-input precondition. Adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/.cache/pip, keyed on runner.os and hashFiles('pyproject.toml') with a restore-keys fallback, reuses downloaded packages across jobs and reruns while preserving every matrix variant, test step, and coverage upload. This matches the measured P-LIT-GHA-CACHE / P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE evidence (pip cache added after setup-python, before install). I did not change fail-fast because the multi-Python-version matrix requires all outcomes, and I did not add a timeout or filters because there is no representative duration history or path-dependency analysis.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
